title: Birth of Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna
introduction: After the completion of Vedic ritual all the kings and Sage Rishyasringa took leave of Dasharatha and went away to their countries. After some time Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata, and Shatrughna are born. Their virtues in childhood and rituals connected thereto are depicted here. Dasharatha then contemplates the marriages of the princes, since marrying sons after completion of education is customary. At that juncture Sage Vishvamitra arrives at the court of Dasharatha seeking help from the king. Dasharatha receives him adoring in high esteem.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टादशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 18th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
निर्वृत्ते तु क्रतौ तस्मिन् हयमेधे महात्मनः |
प्रतिगृह्य सुरा भागान् प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम्
verses.iast:
nir.hvṛtte tu kratau tasmin hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ |
prati gṛhya amarā bhāgān pratijagmuḥ yathā āgatam
verses.translation: On the competition of the horse ritual of high-souled Dasharatha, the golds having received their portion of sacrificial oblation returned to their abodes as they have come.

glosses.meaning: of the high souled one Dasharatha's, that, horse ritual
gods, their portion [of oblations,] on taking

verses.devanagari:
समाप्तदीक्षानियमः पत्नीगणसमन्वितः |
प्रविवेश पुरीं राजा सभृत्यबलवाहनः
verses.iast:
samāpta dīkṣā niyamaḥ patnī gaṇa samanvitaḥ |
praviveśa purīm rājā sa bhṛtya bala vāhanaḥ
verses.translation: The king completing his consecratory vows held for horse ritual, entered Ayodhya city along with the company of his queens, servants, guards and vehicles.

glosses.meaning: on completing, vows, rules - consecration vowed for Vedic ritual

verses.devanagari:
यथार्हं पूजितास्तेन राज्ञा च पृथिवीश्वराः |
मुदिताः प्रययुर्देशान् प्रणम्य मुनिपुंगवम्
verses.iast:
yathā arham pūjitāḥ tena rājñā ca pṛthivīśvarāḥ |
muditāḥ prayayuḥ deśān praṇaṃya muni puṅgavam
verses.translation: The other kings who arrived for the ritual are delighted when befittingly honoured by the king Dasharatha, and they too returned to their countries, after suitably adoring the eminent sage Vashishta.

glosses.meaning: sage, the eminent [Vashishta] on duly adoring

verses.devanagari:
श्रीमतां गच्छतां तेषां स्वगृहाणि पुरात्ततः |
बलानि राज्ञां शुभ्राणि प्रहृष्टानि चकाशिरे
verses.iast:
śrīmatām gacchatām teṣām svagṛhāṇi purāt tataḥ |
balāni rājñām śubhrāṇi prahṛṣṭāni cakāśire
verses.translation: The entourages of those kings who set forth homeward from that city are highly gladdened and shone forth in fine fettle.
notes: Some commentaries said that the soldiers are given white and clean uniforms by Dasharatha by the word śubhrāṇi and hence they are happy. But they may be said to be sprucely without those gifts from Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: to their own, houses [own countries - homeward]
those who are going - set forth
clean [neat white uniforms, or in fine fettle]

verses.devanagari:
गतेषु पृथिवीशेषु राजा दशरथस्तदा |
प्रविवेश पुरीं श्रीमान् पुरस्कृत्य द्विजोत्तमान्
verses.iast:
gateṣu pṛthivīśeṣu rājā daśarathaḥ punaḥ |
praviveśa purīm śrīmān puraskṛtya dvijottamān
verses.translation: On the departure of visiting kings, then that fortunate king Dasharatha entered the city Ayodhya, keeping eminent Brahman priests ahead of him in the procession.

glosses.meaning: earthly, lords [kings,] when they have gone

verses.devanagari:
शांतया प्रययौ सार्धमृष्यशृङ्गः सुपूजितः |
अनुगम्यमानो राज्ञा च सानुयात्रेण धीमता
verses.iast:
śāntayā prayayau sārdham ṛṣyaśṛñgaḥ supūjitaḥ |
anugaṃyamāno rājñā ca sānuyātreṇa dhīmatā
verses.translation: Well adored by king Dasharatha sage Rishyasringa also travelled along with his wife Shanta, followed by his father-in-law King Romapada, and along with other co-travellers, namely the entourage of Romapada.

verses.devanagari:
एवं विसृज्य तान् सर्वान् राजा संपूर्णमानसः |
उवास सुखितस्तत्र पुत्रोत्पत्तिं विचिंतयन्
verses.iast:
evam visṛjya tān sarvān rājā sampUrṇa mānasaḥ |
uvāsa sukhitaḥ tatra putra utpattim vicintayan
verses.translation: On dispersing all of them king Dasharatha gratifyingly dwelled there in Ayodhya, with a satiated heart dwelling upon the birth of his sons.

verses.devanagari:
ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ऋतूनां षट् समत्ययुः |
ततश्च द्वादशे मासे चैत्रे नावमिके तिथौ
नक्षत्रेऽदितिदैवत्ये स्वोच्चसंस्थेषु पंचसु |
ग्रहेषु कर्कटे लग्ने वाक्पताविंदुना सह
प्रोद्यमाने जगन्नाथं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् |
कौसल्याजनयद्रामं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम्
विष्णोरर्धं महाभागं पुत्रमैक्ष्वाकुनंदनम् |
लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुं रक्तौष्ठं दुंदुभिस्वनम्
verses.iast:
tato yajñe samāpte tu ṛtUnām ṣaṭ samatyayuḥ |
tataḥ ca dvādaśe māse caitre nāvamike tithau
nakxatre aditi daivatye sva uccha saṃstheṣu pañcasu |
graheṣu kar.hkaṭe lagne vākpatā indunā saha
prodyamāne jagannātham sarva loka namaskṛtam |
kausalyā ajanayat rāmam sarva lakṣaṇa saṃyutam
viṣṇoḥ ardham mahābhāgam putram aixvāku nandanam |
lohitākśam mahābāhum rak{}ta oṣṭam dundubhi svanam
verses.translation:
On completion of the ritual, six seasons have passed by; then in the twelfth month, i.e., in chaitra mAsa, and on the ninth day of that chaitra month [April-May], when it is punarvasu nakshatra yukta navamI tithi, i.e., when the ruling star of that ninth day is punarvasu, for which Aditi is the presiding deity; and when five of the nine planets - sUrya, kuja, guru, shukra, shani are in ucCha sthAna-s, namely, when those planets are in ascension in their respective houses - meSha, makara, karkaTa, mIna, tula - rAshI-s; and when chandra yukta guru, karkaTa lagne - Jupiter in conjuction with Moon is ascendant in Cancer, and when day is advancing, Queen Kausalya gave birth to a son with all the divine attributes like lotus-red eyes, lengthy arms, roseate lips, voice like drumbeat, and who took birth to delight the Ikshwaku dynasty and adored by all the worlds, and who is the greatly blessed epitome of Vishnu, namely Rama.

Twice six months had rolled a way since the great sacrifice was over and, in the first month of the New Year, on the ninth day of the bright fortnight, the Lord of the worlds chose to take human form and sent down half of His essence as the son of Kausalya (thenceforth to be known as Rama), the world-honored One, the crowning glory ot the grand line of Ikshwku, and the sum of all perfections. The constellation Punarvasu, of which Aditi was the regent, was chosen to preside at his birth. The Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn were in ascension in their respective houses. Aries, Capricornus, Cancer, Pisces and the Libra, Jupiter and the Moon were in conjunction ; the rising sign was Cancer. And KausalyA, shone with unparalleled effulgence, even as Aditi when she gave birth to Indra, the lord of the Shining Ones, the Vajra-wielder. - C. R. Sreeniuasa Aiyangar, 1910.
notes: By this configuration of stars the supreme merits of Rama are indicated. atra sañvastara mukha uttāyaṇa vasanta caitra māsa śukla pakṣa deva nakṣatra diva abhijit lagna puṇya nakṣatrād utkṛṣṭa kāle karkāṭaka lagne uccasya graha pañcake guru candra yoge śrī rāma utpattiḥ | tasya sarva utkṛṣṭatām sakala kalyāṇa guṇa abhiramatām sakala śiṣṭa ādraṇīya sampattim mahā parākramam ca sūcitam | dharmākūtam.

The phrase viṣṇoḥ artham half of Vishnu - is to be taken as half of the fruit of ritual where Vedic ritual itself is pervaded by Vishnu. The fruit of ritual is obtained in the shape of dessert, and Kausalya consumed half of it, but it is not half of Vishnu as he is illimitable. Even Sreeniuasa Aiyangar took it as half, in saying half of Vishnu's essence is Rama. This has become a perennial topic debating whether the incarnation of Rama is a pUrNa avtAra, artha avatAra or aMsha avatAra.

verses.devanagari:
कौसल्या शुशुभे तेन पुत्रेणामिततेजसा |
यथा वरेण देवानामदितिर्वज्रपाणिना
verses.iast:
kausalyā śuśubhe tena putreṇa amita tejasā |
yathā vareṇa devānām aditiḥ vajra pāṇinā
verses.translation: Kausalya shone forth with such a son whose resplendence is unlimited, as with lady Aditi who once stood out with her son Indra, the best one among gods.

glosses.meaning: Lady Aditi, as with, shone forth.

verses.devanagari:
भरतो नाम कैकेय्यां जज्ञे सत्यपराक्रमः |
साक्षाद्विष्णोश्चतुर्भागः सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः
verses.iast:
bharato nāma kaikeyyām jajñe satya parākramaḥ |
sākṣāt viṣṇoḥ caturtha bhāgaḥ sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Queen Kaikeyi gave birth to Bharata, one embodied with all merits, and whose truthfulness itself is his valour and who is fourth component of manifest Vishnu, namely Rama.
notes: The fraction indicated here like 'one fourth of Vishnu' etc may be reckoned as the share of the dessert consumed by the queens, but not as a cleaved portion of Vishnu as he is an indivisible entity. Here it is half of one-fourth i.e., one-eighth of dessert given to Kaikeyi.

glosses.meaning: Bharata, named [son], to Queen Kaikeyi, born to.

verses.devanagari:
अथ लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ सुमित्राजनयत् सुतौ |
वीरौ सर्वास्त्रकुशलौ विष्णोरर्धसमन्वितौ |
verses.iast:
atha laxmaṇa śatrughnau sumitrā ajanayat sutau |
vīrau sarva astra kuśalau viṣṇoḥ ardha samanvitau |
verses.translation: Queen Sumitra then gave birth to two sons who are the embodied epitomes of Vishnu, namely Lakshmana, and Shatrughna, who are valiant ones and experts in all kinds of weaponry.

verses.devanagari:
पुष्ये जातस्तु भरतो मीनलग्ने प्रसन्नधीः |
सार्पे जातौ तु सौमित्री कुळीरेऽभ्युदिते रवौ
verses.iast:
puṣye jātaḥ tu bharato mIna lagne prasanna dhIḥ |
sārpe jātau tu saumitrI kuLIre abhyudite ravau
verses.translation: With the dawn of sun on the next day, fair-minded Bharata is born under Pisces where puSyami is the star of day, later the sons of Sumitra, namely Lakshmana and Shatrughna are born under Cancer, where aaSreSa is the star of the day, i.e., the tenth of chaitra month,
notes: Rama is born on the ninth day of Chaitra month, and Bharata is born in the earlier part of next day the tenth of Chaitra, earlier to his younger brothers, and then Lakshmana and Shatrughna are born on the later part of that tenth day.

'Pushya is the name of a month; but here it means the eighth mansion. The ninth is called Aslesh, or the snake. It is evident from this that Bharata, though his birth is mentioned before that of the twins, was the youngest of the four brothers and Rama's junior by eleven months' -- Schlegel.
The eleven-month gap between Rama and Bharata is unapparent in the words of verse. This may be from some other version of Ramayana.

glosses.meaning: under Pushyami star, in Pisces [of Zodiac,] born
under star presided by serpent [aaSreSa,] in Cancer [of Zodiac]
while Sun, is rising - i.e., on next day of Rama's birth - tenth day of Chaitra

verses.devanagari:
राज्ञः पुत्रा महात्मानश्चत्वारो जज्ञिरे पृथक् |
गुणवंतोऽनुरूपाश्च रुच्या प्रोष्ठपदोपमाः
verses.iast:
rājñaḥ putrā mahātmānaḥ catvāro jajñire pṛthak |
guṇavantaḥ anurūpāḥ ca rucyā proṣṭha padopamāḥ
verses.translation: Thus there are four great-souled sons of Dasharatha, born on separate instances, who are virtuous, charming, and by brilliance they are in similitude with two stars of each of the asterisms called puurva bhadra and uttara bhaadra.
notes: The word proṣṭa is cow; pada feet; the feet of a cow. It is also the name for the asterisms pūrvā bhādra, uttara bādra , containing stars in the wing of Pegasus, each of which will have two stars, and all the four stars make a perfect square. Like the pairs of stars the brother also move in pairs - Rama, Lakshmana; Bharata, Shatrughna.

The epithet mahā ātmanaḥ high-souled ones is though negligible for peripheral reading, it is explained as: Rama is one such, as he undertakes sva dharma anuṣṭhāna ; Lakshmana by his śeṣatva jñāna ; Bharata by his bhagavat pāra tantrya ; and Shatrughna by his bhāgavata pāratantrya.

Like this, each of the epithets used in Ramayana has something or the other meaning which is not generally recorded in English translations. All the English translations are story-oriented, as though there is some unknown story in Ramayana for retelling afresh. In the spate of telling story again and again these niceties are lost. The same is the position with the numerous epithets given to Seetha in Aranya Kanda. Readers may please note that each epithet conveys some meaning and if we could not incorporate them, it is our misfortune in getting a book containing their meanings. We request the readers to kindly inform us if they have come across the meanings of these seemingly useless and metre-filling-like epithets in any book, so that, that book will be brought to the notice of readers who are mistaking them as 'redundant stanza fillers'.

glosses.meaning: [like puurva bhaadra, uttara bhaadra] stars, in simile

verses.devanagari:
जगुः कलं च गंधर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः |
देवदुंदुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खात्पतत्
उत्सवश्च महानासीदयोध्यायां जनाकुलः |
verses.iast:
jaguḥ kalam ca gandharvā nanṛtuḥ ca apsaro gaṇāḥ |
deva dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ ca khāt patat
utsavaḥ ca mahān āsīt ayodhyāyām janākulaḥ |
verses.translation: The celestial singers sang melodiously, paradisiacal dancing parties danced, divine drums drummed and heavens rained flowers, with all this there is a great festivity in Ayodhya with thronging people.

glosses.meaning: divine dancers, groups of - dancing parties, danced
from heavens, flowery, rain, also, fallen

verses.devanagari:
रथ्याश्च जनसंबाधा नटनर्तकसंकुलाः
गायनैश्च विराविण्यो वादनैश्च तथापरैः |
विरेजुर्विपुलास्तत्र सर्वरत्नसमन्विताः
verses.iast:
rathyāḥ ca jana sambādhā naṭa nartaka saṅkulāḥ
gāyanaiḥ ca virāviṇyo vādanaiḥ ca tatha aparaiḥ |
virejur vipulāḥ tatra sarva ratna samanvitāḥ
verses.translation: Hilarity filled the streets with people stampeding them and with the flurry of actors, dancers, singers and instrumentalists, as well by other onlookers, and there on the streets widely strewn are all kinds of gems appreciating the artists.

glosses.meaning: with players of musical instruments, also, thus

verses.devanagari:
प्रदेयांश्च ददौ राजा सूतमागधवंदिनाम् |
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ वित्तं गोधनानि सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
pradeyāṃśca dadau rājā sUta māgadha vandinām |
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittam go dhanāni sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The king gave worthy gifts to eulogisers, bard singers, and panegyrists, and to Brahmans he gave funds and wealth in the form of thousands of cows.

verses.devanagari:
अतीत्यैकादशाहं तु नामकर्म तथाकरोत् |
ज्येष्ठं रामं महात्मानं भरतं कैकयीसुतम्
सौमित्री लक्ष्मणमिति शत्रुघ्नमपरं तथा |
वसिष्ठः परमप्रीतो नामानि कुरुते तदा
verses.iast:
atītya ekādaśa āham tu nāma karma tathā akarot |
jyeṣṭham rāmam mahātmānam bharatam kaikayī sutam
saumitrim lakṣmaṇam iti śatrughnam aparam tathā |
vasiṣṭhaḥ parama prīto nāmāni kurute tadā
verses.translation: Elapsed are eleven days and the naming ceremony is performed. Then Vashishta, the chief priest, named the high-souled elder one as Rama, Kaikeyi's son as Bharata, and one son of Sumitra as Lakshmana and the other as Shatrughna
notes: The word 'Rama' is defined as ramante sarve janāḥ guṇaiḥ asmin iti rāmaḥ 'in whom all the people take delight for his virtuousness, thus he is Rama.' The name Rama is very old, so says padma purāṇa : śriyaḥ kamala vāsinyā rāmeṇa aham mahāprabhuḥ | tasmāt śrī rāma iti asya nāma siddhi purātanam || padma purāṇa
Bharata is defined as: bharata rājya bharanāt - bibharti iti bharata Bharata is because he bears the burden of the kingdom of Rama during Rama's exile.

Lakshmana is lkṣmano laksmi sampannoḥ or lakṣmi asya astīti lakṣmaṇa Lakshmana is the favoured flourisher. The wealth of selfless dedication is in him, hence Lakshmana. One who is endowed with favoured dedication, kainkarya lakśana lakśita Lakshmana is a hearty dedication to Rama and he always wishes to reside by the side of his brother.
Shatrughna is śatrūn hanta iti śatrughnaḥ. Or shatrughno nitya shatru-ghnaH Shatrughna is always an enemy destroyer.

The naming ceremony acquires a particular significance, because Vashishta, the purohita = purā future; hitaḥ well-wisher of; well wishing advisor about the future of the kingdom, named these princes with a vision into the future.

glosses.meaning: one, ten, days, [eleven days,] when elapsed
high souled, elder one, as Rama

verses.devanagari:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयामास पौरान् जानपदानपि |
अददद्ब्राह्मणानां च रत्नौघममितं बहु
तेषां जन्मक्रियादीनि सर्वकर्माण्यकारयत् |
verses.iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa paurān jānapadān api |
udadad brāhmaṇānām ca ratnaugham amalam bahu
teṣām janma kriya ādIni sarva karmāṇi akārayat |
verses.translation: The king feasted Brahmans, urbanites and villagers and he gifted many valuable gems to Brahmans in an unlimited way, and all the rituals of birth and ceremonies sequel to it like naming ceremony, first-food-feeding ceremony, first-hair-removal ceremony, and sacred thread ceremony are performed in respect of the princes.

glosses.meaning: to Brahmans, many, valuable gems, he gave - gifted
them - the princes, birth, rites, ceremonies sequel to it

verses.devanagari:
तेषां केतुरिव ज्येष्ठो रामो रतिकरः पितुः |
बभूव भूयो भूतानां स्वयंभूरिव सम्मतः |
verses.iast:
teṣām ketuḥ iva jyeṣṭho rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ |
babhūva bhūyo bhūtānām svayam bhūḥ iva sammataḥ |
verses.translation: Among those princes the eldest one Rama is like a flagstaff and a delight of his father Dasharatha, and he became acceptable to all beings like the self-created Brahma.

glosses.meaning: among them the princes, eldest one, Rama is
to his father, very much, delightful one

glosses.itrans: svayam bhuu iva bhuutaanaam sammata babhuuva
glosses.iast: svayam bhū iva bhūtānām sammata babhūva
glosses.devanagari: स्वयं भू इव भूतानां सम्मत बभूव
glosses.meaning: self-emerged [god, Brahma,] like, to all beings, acceptable, he became.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे वेदविदः शूराः सर्वे लोकहिते रताः
सर्वे ज्ञानोपसंपन्नाः सर्वे समुदिता गुणैः |
verses.iast:
sarve veda vidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve lokahite ratāḥ
sarve jñānopasampannāḥ sarve samuditā guṇaiḥ |
verses.translation: All the princes are scholars in Veda-s, valiant ones, all are interested in the welfare of the world, all are intellectuals and all of them possess an air of probity.

glosses.meaning: all princes are, in Veda-s, scholars
all are, in worlds', welfare, interested
all are, possessors of, with merits - air of probity.

verses.devanagari:
तेषामपि महातेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः
इष्टः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शशांक इव निर्मलः |
verses.iast:
teṣām api mahātejā rāmaḥ satya parākramaḥ
iṣṭaḥ sarvasya lokasya śaśāṅka iva nirmalaḥ |
verses.translation: Among them the great resplendent Rama, whose valour itself is his truthfulness, is the dear one to all the world like the tranquil moon.

glosses.meaning: Rama, truthfulness, as his valorous one
to all, of world, dear one.

verses.devanagari:
गजस्कन्धेऽश्वपृष्ठे च रथचर्यासु सम्मतः
धनुर्वेदे च निरतः पितृशुश्रूषणे रतः |
verses.iast:
gaja skandhe aśva pṛṣṭe ca ratha caryāsu sammataḥ
dhanur.hvede ca nirataḥ pituḥ śuśṝṣaṇe rataḥ |
verses.translation: Rama is admittedly a champion of riding elephants and horses, also in tactical charioting, and he rejoices in the art of archery, and absorbed in the obedient service of his father.

glosses.meaning: in archery, Veda, also, rejoices in

verses.devanagari:
बाल्यात् प्रभृति सुस्निग्धो लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः
रामस्य लोकरामस्य भ्रातुर्ज्येष्ठस्य नित्यशः |
verses.iast:
bālyāt prabhṛti susnigdho lakṣmaṇo lakṣmi vardhanaḥ
rāmasya lokarāmasya bhrātuḥ jyeṣṭhasya nityaśaḥ |
verses.translation: Right from childhood Lakshmana, the enhancer of prosperity, is always amiable towards his world-charming elder brother Rama.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वप्रियकरस्तस्य रामस्यापि शरीरतः
लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मिसंपन्नो बहिःप्राण इवापरः |
verses.iast:
sarva priya karaḥ tasya rāmasya api śarīrataḥ
lakṣmaṇo lakṣmi sampanno bahiḥ prāṇa iva aparaḥ |
verses.translation: Lakshmana who is endowed with the wealth of dedication dedicated himself to Rama with bodily service, and while performing all agreeable deeds in respect of Rama, he behaved like Rama's alter ego.

glosses.meaning: wealth [of dedication], one endowed with, Lakshmana s, even
bahiH praaNa = outer, life - alter ego, [he behaved like alter ego,].

verses.devanagari:
न च तेन विना निद्रां लभते पुरुषोत्तमः
मृष्टमन्नमुपानीतमश्नाति न हि तं विना |
verses.iast:
na ca tena vinā nidrām labhate puruṣottamaḥ
mṛṣṭam annam upānītam aśnāti na hi tam vinā |
verses.translation: That best one among the men Rama does not get his sleep without Lakshmana and he would not eat food brought for him, however delicious it may be, without Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
यदा हि हयमारूढो मृगयां याति राघवः
तदैनं पृष्ठतोऽभ्येति स धनुः परिपालयन् |
verses.iast:
yadā hi hayam ārūḍho mṛgayām yāti rāghavaḥ
atha enam pṛṣṭhataḥ abhyeti sa dhanuḥ paripālayan |
verses.translation: Whenever Raghava mounts a horse and goes on a hunting game Lakshmana rushes after him wielding his bow as a squire.

glosses.meaning: when, for a hunting game, goes

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्यापि शत्रुघ्नो लक्ष्मणावरजो हि सः
प्राणैः प्रियतरो नित्यं तस्य चासीत्तथा प्रियः |
verses.iast:
bharatasya api śatrughno lakṣmaṇa avarajo hi saḥ
prāṇaiḥ priyataro nityam tasya ca āsīt tathā priyaḥ |
verses.translation: Lakshmana's younger brother Shatrughna is a dear one to Bharata, like that Bharata too held Shatrughna dearer than his own lives.

glosses.meaning: Lakshmana's, born along with - younger brother
like that, he is, a dear one.

verses.devanagari:
स चतुर्भिर्महाभागैः पुत्रैर्दशरथः प्रियैः
बभूव परमप्रीतो देवैरिव पितामहः |
verses.iast:
sa caturbhiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ putraiḥ daśarathaḥ priyaiḥ
babhūva parama prīto devaiḥ iva pitāmahaḥ |
verses.translation: King Dasharatha is highly gladdened with four of his highly fortunate sons like the Forefather Brahma with gods in heaven.

glosses.meaning: he, Dasharatha, mahaa bhaagaiH chaturbhi priyaiH putraiH = with highly fortunate, four, dearest, sons
Forefather, Brahma, with gods, as with

verses.devanagari:
ते यदा ज्ञानसंपन्नाः सर्वे समुदिता गुणैः
ह्रीमन्तः कीर्तिमन्तश्च सर्वज्ञा दीर्घदर्शिनः |
तेषामेवं प्रभावाणां सर्वेषां दीप्ततेजसाम्
पिता दशरथो हृष्टो ब्रह्मा लोकाधिपो यथा |
verses.iast:
te yadā jñāna sampannāḥ sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ
hrīmantaḥ kīrtimantaḥ ca sarvajñā dīrgha darśinaḥ |
teṣām evam prabhāvāṇām sarveṣām dīpta tejasām
pitā daśaratho hṛṣṭo brahmā lokādhipo yathā |
verses.translation: When all of the four sons are thus prospering with prudence, gifted with all the merits, self-conscious to do wrong deeds, well-known for their gentility, knowers of pros and cons and even the conscientious princes, then their father Dasharatha is contented in respect of all of them who are such radiantly brilliant and potential princes, like Brahma.

glosses.meaning: with all, merits, having - gifted with
they [four princes,] when, practical wisdom - prudence, prospering with
bashful ones - self-conscious [to do wrong deeds]
all, knowing ones [knowers of pros and cons]
with this kind of, potentiality having
world, presiding deity - Brahma, as with

verses.devanagari:
ते चापि मनुजव्याघ्रा वैदिकाध्ययने रताः
पितृशुश्रूषणरता धनुर्वेदे च निष्ठिताः |
verses.iast:
te ca api manuja vyāghrā vaidika adhyayane ratāḥ
pitṛ śuśrUṣaṇa ratā dhanur vede ca niṣṭitāḥ |
verses.translation: Even those tigerly-men, namely the princes, are engrossed in the studies of Veda-s, delighted to render service to their father and they are also the experts in art of archery.

glosses.meaning: in art of archery, also, experts.

verses.devanagari:
अथ राजा दशरथस्तेषां दारक्रियां प्रति
चिंतयामास धर्मात्मा सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः |
verses.iast:
atha rājā daśarathaḥ teṣām dāra kriyām prati
cintayāmāsa dharmātmā saha upādhyāyaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ |
verses.translation: Then the noble souled Dasharatha contemplated along with his priestly teachers and relatives about the matrimonial alliances of his sons.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य चिन्तयमानस्य मन्त्रि मध्ये महात्मनः
अभ्यागच्छन्महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः |
verses.iast:
tasya cintayamānasya mantri madhye mahātmanaḥ
abhyāgacchat mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ |
verses.translation: While the great souled Dasharatha is discussing the marriages of princes among his ministers, the highly powerful sage Vishvamitra arrived.

glosses.meaning: while he is thinking so [discussing so]
ministers, among, mahaa tejaa = great resplendent one - highly powerful

verses.devanagari:
स राज्ञो दर्शनाकांक्षी द्वाराध्यक्षानुवाच ह
शीघ्रमाख्यात मां प्राप्तं कौशिकं गाधिनः सुतम् |
verses.iast:
sa rājño darśana ākāṅkṣī dvāra adhyakṣān uvāca ha
śīghram ākhyāta mām prāptam kauśikam gādhinaḥ sutam |
verses.translation: Desirous to have an audience with king Vishvamitra said to the doorkeeper, "Let the king be informed quickly that I, the son of Gadhi from the dynasty of Kushi, have come"

glosses.meaning: to the door, keeper, said to

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य राज्ञो वेश्म प्रदुद्रुवुः
संभ्रान्तमनसः सर्वे तेन वाक्येन चोदिताः |
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya rājño veśma pradudruvuḥ
sambhrānta manasaḥ sarve tena vākyena coditāḥ |
verses.translation: On listening those words all the doorkeepers are dumbfounded, and ushered by those words they quickly rushed to the place of Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: to that, king's [Dasharatha's,] palace, quickly, rushed to.

verses.devanagari:
ते गत्वा राजभवनं विश्वामित्रमृषिं तदा
प्राप्तमावेदयामासुर्नृपायेक्ष्वाकवे तदा |
verses.iast:
te gatvā rāja bhavanam viśvāmitram ṛṣim tadā
prāptam āvedayāmāsuḥ nṛpāyaiḥ ikṣvākave tadā |
verses.translation: Then on their arriving at the king's palace the doorkeepers have announced to the king of Ikshvaku-s, namely Dasharatha, about the arrival of sage Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: they, to king's, palace, having gone

verses.devanagari:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सपुरोधाः समाहितः
प्रत्युज्जगाम संहृष्टो ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः |
verses.iast:
teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā sapurodhāḥ samāhitaḥ
prati ujjagāma saṃhṛṣṭo brahmāṇam iva vāsavaḥ |
verses.translation: On hearing that message from doorkeepers Dasharatha is highly pleased and he has gone towards Vishvamitra in a self-possessed manner along with royal priests, as Indra would ceremoniously go towards Brahma.

glosses.meaning: Indra, like, towards Brahma [in a ceremonial manner.]

verses.devanagari:
तं दृष्ट्वा ज्वलितं दीप्त्या तापसं संशितव्रतम्
प्रहृष्टवदनो राजा ततोऽर्घ्यमुपहारयत् |
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā jvalitam dīptyā tapasam saṃśita vratam
prahṛṣṭa vadano rājā tataḥ arghyam upahārayat |
verses.translation: Then on seeing the resplendent sage Vishvamitra, whose radiance is by his own ascesis and who has severe self-discipline, the king offered water with a gladsome aspect, as first customary hospitality in receiving unexpected guest.

glosses.meaning: one who is radiant, by ascesis

verses.devanagari:
स राज्ञः प्रतिगृह्यार्घ्यं शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा
कुशलं चाव्ययं चैव पर्यपृच्छन्नराधिपम् |
verses.iast:
sa rājñaḥ pratigṛhya arghyam śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
kuśalam ca avyayam ca eva parya pṛcchat narādhipam |
verses.translation: On receiving water from the king scripturally and customarily Vishvamitra enquired after the well-being and welfare of king Dasharatha.

glosses.meaning: scriptural, point of view - scripturally, [also] by practice - customarily

verses.devanagari:
पुरे कोशे जनपदे बान्धवेषु सुहृत्सु च
कुशलं कौशिको राज्ञः पर्यपृच्छत् सुधार्मिकः |
verses.iast:
pure kośe janapade bāndhaveṣu suhṛtsu ca
kuśalam kauśiko rājñaḥ paryapṛcchat sudhārmikaḥ |
verses.translation: That highly righteous sage Vishvamitra asked the king after the well-being of city, exchequer, rural areas, friends and relatives.

glosses.meaning: in city, in exchequer, in rural areas, among relatives

verses.devanagari:
अपि ते संनताः सर्वे सामन्ता रिपवो जिताः
दैवं च मानुषं चैव कर्म ते साध्वनुष्ठितम् |
verses.iast:
api te saṃnatāḥ sarve sāmanta ripavo jitāḥ
daivam ca mānuṣam ca eva karma te sādhu anuṣṭitam |
verses.translation: Sage Vishvamitra asked Dasharatha, "Are all of the provincial kings acquiescent to you, and all your enemies conquered? Are you properly performing the devotional and social works?"

glosses.meaning: provincial kings, all, to you, acquiescent
humanly, also, thus - to administer humans

verses.devanagari:
वसिष्ठं च समागम्य कुशलं मुनिपुंगवः
ऋषींश्च तान् यथान्यायं महाभागानुवाच ह |
verses.iast:
vasiṣṭham ca samāgaṃya kuśalam munipuṅgavaḥ
ṛṣīm ca tān yathā nyāyam mahābhāga uvāca ha |
verses.translation: And on meeting the eminent sage Vashishta and with them the other exalted sages according to custom Vishvamitra asked after their well-being.

verses.devanagari:
ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसस्तस्य राज्ञो निवेशनम्
विविशुः पूजितास्तेन निषेदुश्च यथार्हतः |
verses.iast:
te sarve hṛṣṭa manasaḥ tasya rājño niveśanam
viviśuḥ pūjitāḥ tena niṣeduḥ ca yathā arhataḥ |
verses.translation: Then adoringly invited by the king Dasharatha all of them gladly entered the palace and they took their seats according to protocol.

glosses.meaning: all of them, gladdened, at heart
by him, the king, adored - invited

verses.devanagari:
अथ हृष्टमना राजा विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्
उवाच परमोदारो हृष्टस्तमभिपूजयन् |
verses.iast:
atha hṛṣṭa manā rājā viśvāmitram mahāmunim
uvāca parama udāro hṛṣṭaḥ tam abhipūjayan |
verses.translation: Then the very generous king Dasharatha is gladdened at heart at the arrival of Vishvamitra, and he spoke this way feeling happy to adore that sage.

verses.devanagari:
यथामृतस्य संप्राप्तिर्यथा वर्षमनूदके
यथा सदृशदारेषु पुत्रजन्माप्रजस्य वै |
प्रणष्टस्य यथा लाभो यथा हर्षो महोदये
तथैवागमनं मन्ये स्वागतं ते महामुने |
verses.iast:
yathā amṛtasya samprāptiḥ yathā varṣam anūdake
yathā sadṛśa dāreṣu putra janma aprajasya vai |
praṇaṣṭasya yathā lābho yathā harṣo mahodaye
tathā eva āgamanam manye svāgatam te mahāmune |
verses.translation: "I deem your arrival is in the vein of mortals attaining ambrosia, rainfall in a droughty land, a barren father begetting a son through his deserving wife, a regain of long lost treasures, and the gladness at a great happening, oh, great saint, welcome to you."

glosses.meaning: rain, as with a prajasya = without, progeny [for childless ones]
at great happening, rejoice, as with

verses.devanagari:
कं च ते परमं कामं करोमि किमु हर्षितः
पात्रभूतोऽसि मे ब्रह्मन् दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि मानद |
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम्
यस्माद् विप्रेन्द्रमद्राक्षं सुप्रभाता निशा मम |
verses.iast:
kam ca te paramam kāmam karomi kimu harṣitaḥ
pātra bhūto'si me brahman diṣṭyā prāpto'si mānada |
adya me saphalam janma jīvitam ca su jīvitam
yasmād viprendram adrākśam suprabhātā niśā mama |
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahman, as I am the one who is delighted for your arrival, and as you are the most eligible recipient from me, what is that choicest object of yours to be fulfilled by me, and in which way. Oh, endower of respect, for me your arrival is fortunate whereby my birth is fructified and my life flourished today, and wherefore I could see a great Brahman like you visiting my home, therefore the sun appears to have dawned in my night.

glosses.meaning: [I, who am, at our arrival] delighted
to me, recipient, eligible, you are
for what reason, Brahman, the great, is seen by me [at my own house]

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वं राजर्षिशब्देन तपसा द्योतितप्रभः
ब्रह्मर्षित्वमनुप्राप्तः पूज्योऽसि बहुधा मया |
verses.iast:
pūrvam rājarṣi śabdena tapasā dyotita prabhaḥ
brahmarṣitvam anuprāptaḥ pūjyoasi bahudhā mayā |
verses.translation: "Originally your glory was explicit by your title kingly-sage, and subsequently you attained the Absolute-sainthood by your ascesis, and you are venerable to me, in many ways."

glosses.meaning: indicated - explicit, is your glory – such as you are
by me, in many ways, venerable, you are.

verses.devanagari:
तदद्भुतमभूत् विप्र पवित्रं परमं मम
शुभक्षेत्रगतश्चाहं तव संदर्शनात् प्रभो |
verses.iast:
tat adbhutam abhūt vipra pavitram paramam mama
śubha kṣetra gataḥ ca aham tava sandarśanāt prabho |
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahman, thereby your arrival at my place is surprising and ideally sacred to me, and by your very appearance I have become one who has gone on a quiet pilgrimage.
notes: Dasharatha deems that city itself is sanctified with the arrival of Vishvamitra and thinks that he is like the one who secured the merit of pilgrimage without actually going over a sacred place.

glosses.meaning: to sacred, place, one who has gone - on pilgrimage

verses.devanagari:
ब्रूहि यत् प्रार्थितं तुभ्यं कार्यमागमनं प्रति
इच्छाम्यनुगृहीतोऽहं त्वदर्थं परिवृद्धये |
verses.iast:
brūhi yat prārthitam tubhyam kāryam āgamanam prati
icchām anugṛhīto aham tvadartham parivṛddhaye |
verses.translation: "You may tell me, entreating which work your arrival chanced here and I feel that I am indeed blessed and wish to make it happen to achieve results.

glosses.meaning: arrival, regarding [the work that made you to come]
to its flourish [ to make happen, for fulfilling it,] I wish to.

verses.devanagari:
कार्यस्य न विमर्शं च गंतुमर्हसि सुव्रत
कर्ता चाहमशेषेण दैवतं हि भवान् मम |
verses.iast:
kāryasya na vimarśam ca gantum arhasi suvrata
kartā ca aham aśeṣeṇa daivatam hi bhavān mama |
verses.translation: "It is unapt of you to deliberate about the feasibility of the work, oh, sage with blest vows, while I am the fulfiller of it without any reminder, since you are god to me, indeed.

glosses.meaning: about work, deliberation, to go into, not, apt of you
I am, without, remainder [of work - thoroughly,] the doer
you are, for me, god, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
मम चायमनुप्राप्तो महानभ्युदयो द्विज |
तवागमनजः कृत्स्नो धर्मश्चानुत्तमो द्विज
verses.iast:
mama ca ayam anuprāpto mahān abhyudayo dvija |
tava āgamana jaḥ kṛtsno dharmaḥ ca anuttamo dvija
verses.translation: "Oh, Brahman, this is the great prosperity that bechanced on me, and this is propriety in its entirety that bechanced on me, as a result of your arrival. [1-18-58b, c]

glosses.meaning: for me, this is, great, prosperity, that bechanced
entire, propriety, is the unexcelled one.

verses.devanagari:
इति हृदयसुखं निशम्य वाक्यम्
श्रुतिसुखमात्मवता विनीतमुक्तम् |
प्रथितगुणयशा गुणैर्विशिष्टः
परमऋषिः परमं जगाम हर्षम्
verses.iast:
iti hṛdaya sukham niśaṃya vākyam
śruti sukham ātmavatā vinītam uk{}tam |
prathita guṇa yaśā guṇaiḥ viśiṣṭaḥ
parama ṛṣiḥ paramam jagāma harṣam
verses.translation: On hearing the words of high-minded Dasharatha, said that way in all his humbleness, and those that are pleasant to ears as well to heart, he who is a renowned for his personal attributes and a reputed one by his exceptional qualities, that sublime sage Vishvamitra obtained high rejoice.

glosses.meaning: for heart, pleasing, for ears, pleasing
one who is renowned, [for his personal] attributes, and reputation
